_about: Representation chart data. Each record is a group’s share of the people at one stage, in percent, taken from that stage’s own dataset. Stages are never multiplied or chained. value null = no verified breakdown yet; the chart leaves a gap. derived: true marks a share computed from more than one published figure (see notes). stage-1 inputs are the published access rates behind the derived stage 1 shares and the stage 1 page chart.
